part.name: Corded roller appliance assembly
part.description: A 20-solid corded electromechanical appliance comprising a large protective housing, rear cover and grille components, an internal cylindrical roller/reel assembly, an external U-shaped support cradle, paired connector blocks, a flexible power cord, and a plug. The exact appliance type is uncertain; the geometry is most consistent with a housed roller or reel mechanism.
part.symmetry_note: The main housing and support cradle are approximately bilateral about CAD x=0. Paired connector blocks and cradle pin holes form mirror-like pairs. Internal cylindrical components are predominantly coaxial with the CAD Y direction. The cord path and plug break the overall bilateral symmetry.

semantic_orientation.description: The long housing axis is CAD Y. CAD +Z is interpreted as the appliance top because the +Z view exposes the plan-form opening and the side views place positive Z upward. The y=0 end is treated as the front and the y-max cover/grille end as the back. Left and right follow CAD -X and +X respectively.
